mainsaveWarning.title: Cannot parse the save registry (MAINSAVE.sav)
mainsaveWarning.description: Reading the game's save registry failed, so visibility info is unavailable: all archives may show as hidden, and show/hide, create and delete actions will fail. The archive files themselves are unaffected. If the game updated recently, its new save format may not be supported yet — please report the error details below to the developers.
